verdict.rationale: C is cheapest and earliest but has two connections; D is later and more expensive but has only one reasonably timed connection; B is cheaper than D and has a much larger connection buffer, at the cost of a substantially later arrival and long layover. Selecting among these requires unstated priorities regarding cost, time, and connection-risk tolerance. A is not comparably competitive because it uses the wrong regional airport, requires a rental-car transfer, costs more than D, and arrives later.
